title: Cannot Wait to Verify: Parallel Drafting to Eliminate Verifier Idle Time in Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.27477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive inference in large transformer models is limited by token-level sequential execution, resulting in high latency and low GPU utilization. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this bottleneck by introducing a draft-and-verifier model. However, the drafting stage remains sequential, leaving the verifier idle and underutilizing compute. To address this, we propose a plug-and-play drafting adaptive drafting method that parallelizes inference across transformer layers during draft generation. Starting from a shared hidden state, our approach evaluates multiple layers in parallel and verifies consistency by measuring divergence in hidden-state space. Layer-wise draft states are accepted when deviations are small; otherwise, a correction step is applied. By exploiting redundancy across transformer layers, our method accelerates draft generation and improves hardware utilization without modifying architectures or requiring retrainin

translated_title: 迫不及待去验证：通过并行草稿生成消除推测解码中验证器的空闲时间
translated_abstract: 大型Transformer模型中的自回归推理受限于token级的顺序执行，导致高延迟和低GPU利用率。推测解码通过引入草稿模型-验证器模型的组合来缓解这一瓶颈。然而，草稿生成阶段仍然是顺序执行的，导致验证器处于空闲状态，计算资源未得到充分利用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种即插即用的自适应草稿生成方法，在草稿生成过程中跨Transformer层并行化推理。从共享的隐藏状态出发，我们的方法并行评估多个层，并通过测量隐藏状态空间中的散度来验证一致性。当偏差较小时，逐层草稿状态被接受；否则，将应用纠正步骤。通过利用Transformer层间的冗余性，我们的方法加速了草稿生成并提高了硬件利用率，且无需修改模型架构或进行重新训练。
tldr: 提出一种即插即用的并行草稿生成方法，通过跨Transformer层并行推理并结合隐藏状态散度一致性验证与纠正机制，消除了推测解码中验证器的空闲等待时间，在无需修改架构或重新训练的情况下加速草稿生成并提升硬件利用率。
en_tdlr: A plug-and-play parallel drafting method that evaluates multiple transformer layers concurrently with hidden-state divergence-based consistency verification and correction, eliminating verifier idle time in speculative decoding and accelerating draft generation without architectural modifications or retraining.
